LESSON: CARE OF THE TEETH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.2: Care of the teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Care of the teeth. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CARE OF THE TEETH
This lesson teaches Care of the teeth for Grade 1 HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Care of the teeth using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Care of the teeth above.
2. Explain Care of the teeth to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Care of the teeth.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care of the teeth with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Care of the teeth important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. observe hygienic practices stories about shedding milk teeth during shedding of milk teeth, during childhood
